title: Session Heartbeat
description: Emitted every 30s while the session is active (page is visible AND user has been active in the last 60s). Used for engagement / time-on-task analytics.

isActive.description: True if user has produced any input event (mouse, keyboard, touch) in the last 60s

currentItemId.description: Current content item being interacted with (module/quiz/lab id), if any

viewportPercentVisible.description: Fraction of viewport currently containing visible content (vs blank/header/footer)
